definition: exit 0: every rendered number equals the lock, a hashed sidecar, a labelled fixture or a lock-derived quantity at the display precision of ui/tokens.py; placeholders (PLACEHOLDER / FIXTURE / pending) and UNHASHED live values (route driver without an out/live record) are allowed and listed; ambiguity = number of distinct reference values that would have matched (coincidence risk)
notes: out/sensitivity.json has no .sha256 sidecar and is not in the lock: its numbers are shown on the validation page as an unsigned asset
out/validation/*.json (Workstream 3 scorecards) have no .sha256 sidecar; the pages print the file sha256 next to the values, so they are matched as on-screen-hashed assets
Monza LIN: no hashed out/live record for the route driver; the live numbers were reproduced in-process (live/viewmodel.results_through) and are listed as UNHASHED
